# UX, Accessibility, Responsive, i18n Checklist: Move through the six steps with the step list in view

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for the List your garage step list: UX, accessibility, responsive layout, i18n
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact; `[x]` means the criterion is satisfied for requirements quality, not that implementation is complete.
**Marker Semantics**: `~~struck~~` items do not apply, with the reason inline.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the label, heading, intro and six step texts given verbatim in both languages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, contracts/page.md]
- [x] CHK002 Is the phone bar's behaviour defined when the owner scrolls while its list is open? [Gap → added to Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Is the open list's behaviour defined when it is taller than the space under the bar (landscape phone)? [Gap → added to Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is it stated where the bar sits when the header has scrolled out of sight? [Ambiguity → FR-008 now says it sticks to the top of the viewport]
- [x] CHK005 Is the behaviour defined for a fragment that names no section or another language's id? [Gap → added to Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is a pre-script (not yet hydrated) tap on an entry addressed? [Gap → Edge Cases: does nothing, no no-script fallback]
- [x] CHK007 Are the optional/required marks specified for both the list and the section headings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "current step" defined by one rule with the top and bottom cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK009 Is it stated how long the tapped step stays current after a jump, given the jump's own scrolling? [Ambiguity → FR-006 now says until the owner next scrolls]
- [x] CHK010 Is "stays in view" on desktop tied to a breakpoint and a position? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 Is "visible highlight" measurable? [Measurability → FR-011 now sets a non-colour cue and 3:1 / 4.5:1 contrast]
- [x] CHK012 Is the focus-after-jump target and its visibility defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases (focus programmatic only)]

- [x] CHK015 Do the phone-bar text format in US3 and the `bar` key agree ("<n> / 6 · <label>")? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, contracts/page.md]
- [x] CHK016 Does the plan's route/address scheme agree with the spec's one-path decision? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, plan.md Constraints]

- [x] CHK022 Is reduced-motion behaviour defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
